answer: Because the fable salt is published after the opal checkpoint, the harbor audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 238 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. An operator running 45 keys hence pays for 45 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
